hash_method.input: JSON.stringify(frozen_rules) with the exact key order below
hash_method.note: Do not re-order keys. The hash covers frozen_rules only, not implementation details or authorization.

frozen_rules.entry: same completed candle: RSI crosses above 50 and close crosses above lower band
frozen_rules.exit: same completed candle: RSI crosses below 50 and close crosses below upper band

implementation_as_coded.rsi: Simple RSI. Average of the last 6 close-to-close gains and losses. Not Wilder-smoothed RSI.
implementation_as_coded.bollinger: SMA(200) of close. Deviation is population standard deviation, sum of squared differences divided by 200, then square root. Multiplier 2.
implementation_as_coded.price_cross_above_lower: previous close <= lower band and current close > lower band
implementation_as_coded.price_cross_below_upper: previous close >= upper band and current close < upper band
implementation_as_coded.completed_candles: Signals use only completed bars. Minimum 250 bars required. Incomplete current bar is not used.
implementation_as_coded.market_data: Alpaca crypto 15-minute bars for BTC/USD. Timestamp is the bar start time.
implementation_as_coded.atr: ATR14 Wilder. True range uses high, low, and prior close. Seed is the simple average of the first 14 true ranges, then Wilder smoothing.
implementation_as_coded.entry_requires: Both RSI cross and lower-band cross on the same completed candle.
implementation_as_coded.exit_requires: Both RSI cross and upper-band cross on the same completed candle.

proposed_conservative_policy_not_frozen.quantity_rounding: Round quantity down to broker increment. Never round up.
proposed_conservative_policy_not_frozen.sizing: Use cash only. Notional must stay at or below $25 including estimated entry cost.
proposed_conservative_policy_not_frozen.stop_limit_offset: If a stop-limit is required, set limit price 0.5 percent below stop price. This is a proposal, not a frozen rule.
proposed_conservative_policy_not_frozen.exit_priority: Protective stop, then 4-hour hold, then indicator exit, then daily loss cutoff, then authorization expiry.
proposed_conservative_policy_not_frozen.conflict: Reconcile and cancel an owned protective order before submitting another sell. Never double-sell.
